# DarkRoomLibrary v1.2.6

This maintenance release strengthens reproducible delivery without changing product behavior.

## Changes

- Stabilized the automated backend evidence at `284/284` tests and `3813/5277` covered lines (`72.25%`, rounded down).
- Refreshed pinned GitHub Actions dependencies and pull-request workflow triggers.
- Added an explicit append-only guard that rejects an already published stable release before packaging, plus a repository gate that prevents silent removal of that guard.
- Clarified that the per-email daily verification-code budget counts delivery attempts. Failed mail delivery releases the short resend slot but does not refund the daily attempt budget.
- Made no business logic, database schema, API, or frontend domain changes.

## Verification boundary

- The release tag must point to `main`, pass the complete CI workflow, and have a successful Security workflow for the exact same commit.
- The release workflow verifies the repository version contract before producing the source ZIP, SHA-256 checksum, manifest, and SPDX SBOM.
- Existing single-instance, browser, concurrency, middleware-degradation, and historical three-instance evidence remains explicitly dated; this maintenance release does not claim to have rerun those real chains.
